# FDN Burrog Befuddler: "Flash. When this creature enters, target creature an opponent controls
# gets -1/-0 until end of turn."
# Event: the compiler's "When this creature enters". Effect: ZNR Drana's Silencer's "target
# creature an opponent controls gets -X/-X until end of turn" (B8-party-minus-x-opponent: the
# TARGET slot with CONTROLLER_IS opponent, MODIFY_PT with DurationEot) at -1/-0, written as
# M21 Rookie Mistake's and ZNR Beyeen Veil's "-2/-0" (toughness DECREASE 0).
etb = TriggeredAbility(
    event=ZoneChangeEvent(
        from_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.ANY, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),
        to_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
        subject=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE),
    ),
    condition=None,
    effect=A(Verb.MODIFY_PT, {
        'duration': DurationEot(),
        'power': PtDelta(direction=PtDirection.DECREASE, magnitude=QConst(value=1)),
        'target': Selector(
            count=QConst(value=1),
            mode=SelectorMode.TARGET,
            filter=FAnd(
                children=(
                    FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.OPPONENT),
                    FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Creature'),
                ),
            ),
            zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
        ),
        'toughness': PtDelta(direction=PtDirection.DECREASE, magnitude=QConst(value=0)),
    }),
)
abilities = [etb, *compiled]

clauses.clause: When this creature enters, target creature an opponent controls gets -1/-0 until end of turn.
clauses.ir: abilities[0] (MODIFY_PT -1/-0, DurationEot, TARGET creature an opponent controls)

mapping.notes: Drana's Silencer's 'target creature an opponent controls gets -X/-X until end of turn' at -1/-0, written as Rookie Mistake's and Beyeen Veil's '-N/-0' (toughness DECREASE 0). Flash compiles. Packs: tools/scenarios/mapped/FDN/burrog_befuddler_effect_ends_with_the_turn.json, tools/scenarios/mapped/FDN/burrog_befuddler_minus_one_power_this_turn.json.
